per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  Movie.title AS Unkrich_Movie_Title,
  Movie.production_company AS Unkrich_Movie_Company,
  Singalong.title AS Singalong_Title,
  Singalong.production_company AS Singalong_Company
FROM 
  Movies AS Movie
JOIN 
  Directors AS Director ON Movie.director_id = Director.id
JOIN 
  Singalongs AS Singalong ON Singalong.title LIKE '%Mary Poppins%'
WHERE 
  Director.name = 'Lee Unkrich';
Did Lee Unkrich co-direct the Pixar film "Coco," and was "Mary Poppins" produced by Walt Disney Productions, both of which are under The Walt Disney Company?
